sentences: The terminal releases the session when the user presses the stop button.
Before releasing, it answers any pending SessionUpdate message with a SessionUpdateComplete message.
After releasing, it deletes the stored parameters and turns off CCH1.
Releasing takes less than two seconds.

requirements.text: The terminal shall release the session when the user presses the stop button.
Before releasing the session, the terminal shall answer any pending SessionUpdate message with a SessionUpdateComplete message.
After releasing the session, the terminal shall delete the stored parameters.
After releasing the session, the terminal shall turn off CCH1.
Releasing the session shall take less than two seconds.
